defmodule Rocola.Spotify.Fake do
  @moduledoc """
  In-memory Spotify for dev and test: ~50 seeded songs, 2 devices (one `is_restricted`),
  and simulated playback. Mirrors real API limits: add-only queue, restricted devices
  reject commands, playback needs an active device. No network, no token.
  """
  use Agent
  @behaviour Rocola.Spotify

  @artists ~w(Aurora Lumen Nova Tidal Ember Vesper Quartz Harbor Willow Cobalt)
  @words ~w(Midnight Echo Golden Static Paper)

  @tracks (for {a, i} <- Enum.with_index(@artists), {w, j} <- Enum.with_index(@words) do
             %{
               uri: "fake:track:#{i}-#{j}",
               name: "#{w} #{a}",
               artist: a,
               duration_ms: 150_000 + i * 7_000 + j * 3_000
             }
           end)

  @devices [
    %{
      id: "fake-living-room",
      name: "Living Room (Fake Sonos)",
      is_active: false,
      is_restricted: false
    },
    %{
      id: "fake-locked",
      name: "Locked Speaker (restricted)",
      is_active: false,
      is_restricted: true
    }
  ]

  def start_link(_),
    do: Agent.start_link(fn -> %{devices: @devices, queue: [], now: nil} end, name: __MODULE__)

  @doc "Back to the seeded state (for tests)."
  def reset, do: Agent.update(__MODULE__, fn _ -> %{devices: @devices, queue: [], now: nil} end)

  @impl true
  def search(q) do
    q = String.downcase(q)

    {:ok,
     Enum.filter(@tracks, &String.contains?(String.downcase(&1.name <> " " <> &1.artist), q))}
  end

  @impl true
  def devices, do: {:ok, Agent.get(__MODULE__, & &1.devices)}

  @impl true
  def transfer_playback(id) do
    Agent.get_and_update(__MODULE__, fn s ->
      case Enum.find(s.devices, &(&1.id == id)) do
        nil -> {{:error, :device_not_found}, s}
        %{is_restricted: true} -> {{:error, :restricted_device}, s}
        _ -> {:ok, %{s | devices: Enum.map(s.devices, &%{&1 | is_active: &1.id == id})}}
      end
    end)
  end

  @impl true
  def add_to_queue(uri) do
    Agent.get_and_update(__MODULE__, fn s ->
      cond do
        not Enum.any?(s.devices, & &1.is_active) ->
          {{:error, :no_active_device}, s}

        track = Enum.find(@tracks, &(&1.uri == uri)) ->
          {:ok, advance(%{s | queue: s.queue ++ [track]})}

        true ->
          {{:error, :track_not_found}, s}
      end
    end)
  end

  @impl true
  def queue, do: {:ok, Agent.get(__MODULE__, & &1.queue)}

  @impl true
  def now_playing, do: {:ok, Agent.get(__MODULE__, & &1.now)}

  # ponytail: no timer; the first queued song starts playing immediately. Add a
  # Process.send_after tick that pops the queue when real-time playback sim is needed.
  defp advance(%{now: nil, queue: [t | rest]} = s), do: %{s | now: t, queue: rest}
  defp advance(s), do: s
end

defmodule Rocola.Spotify.Web do
  @moduledoc "Real Spotify Web API adapter (Req + TokenServer). Stub until real playback is wanted."
  @behaviour Rocola.Spotify

  @impl true
  def search(_), do: {:error, :not_implemented}
  @impl true
  def devices, do: {:error, :not_implemented}
  @impl true
  def transfer_playback(_), do: {:error, :not_implemented}
  @impl true
  def add_to_queue(_), do: {:error, :not_implemented}
  @impl true
  def queue, do: {:error, :not_implemented}
  @impl true
  def now_playing, do: {:error, :not_implemented}
end
# 001: Architecture

## Decisions
- **Spotify behind a behaviour.** `Rocola.Spotify` defines the callbacks; `Fake` (default in dev/test)
  and `Web` (real API + `TokenServer`, stub) implement them. Switching is config plus credentials.
  Why: build and test with no account, token or network.
- **Own queue.** Spotify's API can add to its queue but not remove or reorder, so Rocola keeps its
  queue in SQLite (skips, votes, per-guest limits) and feeds Spotify one song ahead.
- **Fake mirrors real limits** (add-only queue, restricted devices, active device required) so
  behaviour proven against it carries over to the real adapter.
- **Stack:** Phoenix LiveView, SQLite (`ecto_sqlite3`), `mix release` for aarch64 on a Raspberry Pi.
- **Tidewave** (dev only) gives the coding agent access to the running app over MCP.
defmodule Rocola.Spotify.FakeTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
  alias Rocola.Spotify

  setup do
    Rocola.Spotify.Fake.reset()
    :ok
  end

  test "search finds seeded songs, case-insensitive" do
    assert {:ok, [_ | _] = r} = Spotify.search("aurora")
    assert Enum.all?(r, &(&1.artist == "Aurora"))
  end

  test "has 50 songs and one restricted device" do
    assert {:ok, all} = Spotify.search("")
    assert length(all) == 50
    assert {:ok, devs} = Spotify.devices()
    assert [%{is_restricted: true}] = Enum.filter(devs, & &1.is_restricted)
  end

  test "restricted devices reject playback transfer" do
    assert {:error, :restricted_device} = Spotify.transfer_playback("fake-locked")
  end

  test "queueing needs an active device, then first song plays and the rest queue (add-only)" do
    [a, b] = Enum.take(elem(Spotify.search(""), 1), 2)
    assert {:error, :no_active_device} = Spotify.add_to_queue(a.uri)
    :ok = Spotify.transfer_playback("fake-living-room")
    :ok = Spotify.add_to_queue(a.uri)
    :ok = Spotify.add_to_queue(b.uri)
    assert {:ok, ^a} = Spotify.now_playing()
    assert {:ok, [^b]} = Spotify.queue()
  end
end
defmodule Rocola.Application do
  # See https://elixir.hexdocs.pm/Application.html
  # for more information on OTP Applications
  @moduledoc false

  use Application

  @impl true
  def start(_type, _args) do
    children = [
      RocolaWeb.Telemetry,
      Rocola.Repo,
      {Ecto.Migrator,
       repos: Application.fetch_env!(:rocola, :ecto_repos), skip: skip_migrations?()},
      {DNSCluster, query: Application.get_env(:rocola, :dns_cluster_query) || :ignore},
      {Phoenix.PubSub, name: Rocola.PubSub},
      # Start a worker by calling: Rocola.Worker.start_link(arg)
      # {Rocola.Worker, arg},
      # Start to serve requests, typically the last entry
      Rocola.Spotify.Fake,
      RocolaWeb.Endpoint
    ]

    # See https://elixir.hexdocs.pm/Supervisor.html
    # for other strategies and supported options
    opts = [strategy: :one_for_one, name: Rocola.Supervisor]
    Supervisor.start_link(children, opts)
  end

  # Tell Phoenix to update the endpoint configuration
  # whenever the application is updated.
  @impl true
  def config_change(changed, _new, removed) do
    RocolaWeb.Endpoint.config_change(changed, removed)
    :ok
  end

  defp skip_migrations?() do
    # By default, sqlite migrations are run when using a release
    System.get_env("RELEASE_NAME") == nil
  end
end

defmodule Rocola.Jukebox do
  @moduledoc """
  Skip votes. When `@needed` distinct guests vote on the song now playing, it is skipped.
  Votes are per song and reset when the song changes.
  """
  use Agent
  alias Rocola.Spotify

  @needed 2

  # ponytail: in-memory; votes are lost on restart. Move to SQLite with the own-queue work.
  def start_link(_), do: Agent.start_link(fn -> %{uri: nil, voters: MapSet.new()} end, name: __MODULE__)

  @doc "Back to no votes (for tests)."
  def reset, do: Agent.update(__MODULE__, fn _ -> %{uri: nil, voters: MapSet.new()} end)

  @spec vote_skip(guest_id :: String.t()) ::
          {:ok, {:voted, pos_integer()}} | {:ok, :skipped} | {:error, term}
  def vote_skip(guest_id) do
    Agent.get_and_update(__MODULE__, fn s ->
      with {:ok, %{uri: uri}} <- now_playing() do
        voters = if s.uri == uri, do: s.voters, else: MapSet.new()
        voters = MapSet.put(voters, guest_id)

        if MapSet.size(voters) >= @needed do
          case Spotify.skip() do
            :ok -> {{:ok, :skipped}, %{uri: nil, voters: MapSet.new()}}
            err -> {err, s}
          end
        else
          {{:ok, {:voted, MapSet.size(voters)}}, %{uri: uri, voters: voters}}
        end
      else
        {:ok, nil} -> {{:error, :nothing_playing}, s}
        err -> {err, s}
      end
    end)
  end

  defp now_playing, do: Spotify.now_playing()
end
E

defmodule Rocola.JukeboxTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
  alias Rocola.{Jukebox, Spotify}

  setup do
    Spotify.Fake.reset()
    Jukebox.reset()
    :ok = Spotify.transfer_playback("fake-living-room")
    [a, b, c] = Enum.take(elem(Spotify.search(""), 1), 3)
    Enum.each([a, b, c], &Spotify.add_to_queue(&1.uri))
    %{a: a, b: b}
  end

  test "nothing playing" do
    Spotify.Fake.reset()
    assert {:error, :nothing_playing} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g1")
  end

  test "2 distinct guests skip to the next song; same guest twice does not", %{a: a, b: b} do
    assert {:ok, {:voted, 1}} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g1")
    assert {:ok, {:voted, 1}} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g1")
    assert {:ok, ^a} = Spotify.now_playing()
    assert {:ok, :skipped} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g2")
    assert {:ok, ^b} = Spotify.now_playing()
  end

  test "votes reset for the next song" do
    {:ok, {:voted, 1}} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g1")
    {:ok, :skipped} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g2")
    assert {:ok, {:voted, 1}} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g1")
  end
end

content.text:
Skip voting is in, and `mix precommit` passes (12 tests, including three new ones).

- **Voting:** `Rocola.Jukebox.vote_skip(guest_id)` records one vote per guest for the song now playing. On the second distinct guest it skips to the next queued song. Voting twice as the same guest still counts as one vote.
- **Reset:** Votes reset whenever the song changes. If nothing is playing, it returns `{:error, :nothing_playing}`.
- **New `skip` callback:** `Rocola.Spotify` gets a `skip` callback, per rule 3. The Fake implements it and needs an active device, like `add_to_queue`. The `Web` adapter returns `:not_implemented`.
- **Tests:** New tests are in `test/rocola/jukebox_test.exs`.

Things you might trip over:

- **No UI yet:** There is no LiveView or guest identity in the repo, so there is no skip button. A `RequestLive` button would just call `Jukebox.vote_skip(session_id)`.
- **Votes lost on restart:** Votes live in memory (`Agent`) because the SQLite queue from the ADR doesn't exist yet. Move them to the DB when that queue lands.
- **Passing mid-run error:** The precommit run logged one `database is locked` error from `Exqlite` during startup. It did not fail any test.
